title: Figure 18: 'Perfect' narrow-band microwave absorber - unit cell and simulated spectra
description: Panels (a)-(c) show the unit-cell design of a metamaterial absorber with dimension labels and a 3D layered view with field vectors. Right panel plots reflectance, absorbance and transmission versus frequency (9-14 GHz), with a sharp absorption peak near 11.5 GHz. Caption: "Figure 18. 'Perfect' Narrow-Band Microwave Absorber." Appears under the heading "Metamaterials for Energy Harvesting."
